verification.note: Confirmed. A grep for `deferNavigation` across the repository finds the switch defined at notesAppHarness.tsx:72 and re-exported at clipsAppHarness.tsx:20. Only one call passes `true`: notesTargetChangeWhileEditing.test.tsx:170, the single case that switches to All notes from `?view=all&note=n1&sort=created`. clipsTargetChangeOnHome.test.tsx imports it (line 9) but only calls `deferNavigation(false)`, in afterEach at line 92. No Clips test runs with deferred navigation. NotesPage.tsx:173-176 now replaces only when `next.toString() !== current.toString()`, which is the r5 R2 fix. Every Notes Target-change test chooses the Target on a Library URL that holds `sort`, or `note`, or both. Those tests are notesViewPerTarget.test.tsx:238, 270, 273 and 351, notesLibrary.test.tsx:769 and 1050, and notesTargetChangeWhileEditing.test.tsx:139, 154 and 171. The remaining Target-choice tests either choose on Home (notesFrame.test.tsx:304) or open at 1440px, where the fill-in has already added `sort`. So none of these tests takes the branch where nothing differs and the replace is skipped, under either harness mode. This was confirmed by reading only; no tests were run.

specification_compliance: I13 (r4) and I4 assume that the router's replace lands after the Target state commits. Only one Notes test models that ordering, and no Clips test does.
regression_risks: A regression in the Clips Target-change ordering, or in the Notes path that skips the replace, under real App Router transition semantics would not be caught by vitest.
test_coverage: No test covers a Notes Target choice from a Library URL that has neither `sort` nor `note`, for example on an empty previous Target or at the phone layout.
No Clips test chooses a Target with deferred navigation.
not_verified: No tests were run; every conclusion comes from reading the code.

I did not read clipsViewPerTarget.test.tsx, clipsLibrary.test.tsx, clipsPage.test.tsx or clipsFrame.test.tsx in full. The grep shows none of them calls deferNavigation(true), but I did not check whether any of them takes Clips' no-op-replace path under the synchronous harness.
I did not trace pages/clips.tsx to confirm that the r5 R2 guard there matches the Notes one.
